messages:
Jing: quick follow-up on the model-versioning metadata RFC — we need a small set of clarifications for tombstones/provenance and how clients should react. TL;DR: propose a soft vs hard expiry, a provenance blob, and a numeric preference signal.

Evan: can you list the minimal required fields? trying to keep client parsing trivial.

Jing: minimal I'd like: model_id, version, provenance, compat_tags, soft_expiry_ts (optional), tombstone_reason (optional), signal_weight (default 1.0). everything else opt-in.

Clare: +1 on minimal. One gotcha: "provenance" needs to be machine-parseable (commit id + model-card URL) so ops can reconcile model artifacts automatically. e.g. `git+https://...@<sha>` or `s3://bucket/path#sha`.

Evan: what about semantics of soft_expiry_ts vs tombstone/hard_expiry? we need deterministic client behavior for fallback vs 404.

Jing: propose semantics: soft_expiry_ts = timestamp when runtime should prefer a fallback but still serve with warning header; tombstone_hard_ts = timestamp after which any requests return 410. Also include tombstone_reason for audit. Clients: on receiving warning header, attempt pinned-version fallback if available.

Clare: also suggest a deprecation_window_days integer on rollout manifests so we can automate notification and auto-fallback policies in Console. e.g. deprecation_window_days: 14 => send notices starting at soft_expiry_ts - 14d.

ops-bot: deploy: metadata-schema v0.7 rolled to staging (:rocket:). See https://internal/redwood/schemas/meta/v0.7

Evan: ok, helmet question — should "signal_weight" be used for routing priority or for blending in A/B scenarios? we already have routing weights elsewhere.

Jing: keep it simple: signal_weight is a per-model float used by the resolver as a tiebreaker when policies are equal. explicit routing policies override it. it helps for gradual handoff without adding a new routing primitive.

Clare: for observability — we must include a telemetry_key or quality_guard tag so monitoring can auto-register eval sets against the version. Otherwise ops will miss regressions during soft-expiry period.

Jing: agreed. adding "telemetry_keys": ["smoke_suite_v2","latency_v1"]. Also add an optional `client_contracts` list for things like ["preserve-kvcache","max-seq-2048"].

Evan: please paste an example metadata blob so SDK folks can implement parsing quickly. keep it minimal.

Jing: example: ```json
{
  "model_id": "rw-inspect-7b",
  "version": "2026-03-15+abc123",
  "provenance": "git+https://git.redwood/inference/models@abc123",
  "compat_tags": ["float16","seq512"],
  "signal_weight": "0.85",
  "soft_expiry_ts": "1770006000",
  "tombstone_hard_ts": "1770600000",
  "tombstone_reason": "security-fix-needed",
  "telemetry_keys": ["smoke_v2","llm-qa-sets"],
  "client_contracts": ["preserve-kvcache"]
}```

Clare: nit: make signal_weight numeric (0..1) not string. SDK should validate range. Also ensure timestamps are seconds-since-epoch.

Evan: how do we handle retroactive metadata changes (e.g., we update tombstone_reason after the version is already pinned in Dedicated)? need immutability vs mutability contract.

Jing: propose: immutable fields: model_id, version, provenance; mutable fields: soft_expiry_ts, tombstone_reason, tombstone_hard_ts, signal_weight, telemetry_keys. Update events must be emitted with a monotonic edit_id and a small audit log showing who changed it. We can add `edit_id` to metadata diffs.

Clare: and add a `last_edit_by` + `last_edit_ts` to make reconciliations simpler. ops will thank us.

eng-plat: action items that came out of this thread: 1) update schema doc with soft/hard expiry semantics and telemetry_keys 2) add migration script to backfill telemetry_keys for prod models 3) SDK spec: how to treat warning headers & fallback behavior 4) add unit tests for signal_weight parsing. I'll put cards on the board.

Jing: thanks. i'll file the follow-up RFC PR against schemas repo and include the example blob + validation rules. tagging @eng-plat for review. :+1:

Clare: ack. i'll draft the Console notification UX for deprecation_window_days.

Evan: i'll add telemetry registration to the onboarding checklist.

ops-bot: note: staging telemetry smoke will run nightly on v0.7 schema starting tomorrow.
